description: Large-scale heterogeneous knowledge graph from Wikidata 2021 dump. Contains ~5M entities connected by 822 relation types with ~21M triples. Each entity paired with Wikipedia article text for joint structured-unstructured modeling. Supports transductive and inductive link prediction settings.
name: Wikidata5M
